en: Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a European riverside city. A bridge crosses a wide river in the foreground, with a row of multi‑story buildings and a church with an onion‑shaped dome and clock tower on the right. In the background rises a wooded hill topped with fortifications and a prominent clock tower on the slope. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the scene as Graz with the Mur river and the Schlossberg hill.
